about: The console password's stored form (T-0864): the installer's setup page hashes the password the person chooses (deploy/setup/server.py hash_password) and the console verifies it (aura-web/src/lib/server/consoleAuth.ts verifyPassword). Both suites read these rows: Python must produce each line from its password and salt, the console must accept each line for its password and refuse it for another. Surrounding spaces are not part of a password on either side.

rows.note: decomposed and compatibility spellings: both sides derive from the NFKC form, so the same password typed on another keyboard is the same password
